items.title: MOFSL stays bullish on Sun Pharma; sees 16% upside on innovation pipeline
items.description: Sun Pharma's June quarter results met analyst expectations, signaling future growth.  The company is expanding its specialty and innovative medicines portfolio significantly.  Strategic initiatives like semaglutide launches and the Organon acquisition are key drivers.  Despite US generics pressure, domestic business and specialty products show strong momentum.  Analysts maintain a positive outlook, anticipating substantial growth from these ventures.

items.title: Oil PSUs' June quarter losses miss govt's ₹75,000 crore estimate by wide margin
items.description: State-run oil firms reported combined net losses of ₹18,149 crore in the June quarter. This figure was significantly lower than the government's initial projection of nearly ₹75,000 crore. Industry executives cited retail price increases and central tax reductions as key cushioning factors. Higher LPG prices also helped offset cooking gas sales losses for these companies. The divergence highlights the political sensitivity surrounding fuel price adjustments and public perception.

items.title: Value addition key for Tata Steel as prices fall and costs increase
items.description: Tata Steel saw strong revenue growth in the June quarter, driven by higher realisations. However, global steel prices are softening, and coking coal costs are rising.  The company expects domestic realisations to decrease in the September quarter.  Tata Steel is increasing its focus on value-added products and expanding its NINL facility. This strategic shift aims to strengthen its position in high-margin segments.

items.title: One MobiKwik Q1 Results: Firm reports profit for 3rd consecutive quarter; stock jumps 9% on strong performance
items.description: Fintech firm MobiKwik reported a consolidated profit of Rs 7.6 crore for the April-June quarter. This marks a significant turnaround from a net loss of Rs 419.2 crore in the prior year. Revenue from operations saw a modest increase of 3.7 percent to Rs 281.48 crore. The company highlighted three consecutive profitable quarters, reinforcing its business model's embedded profitability.

items.title: Ather Energy Q1 Results: Loss narrows YoY to Rs 51 crore on stronger sales
items.description: Ather Energy, the Indian electric scooter manufacturer, has announced a significant reduction in its quarterly losses, attributing this positive outcome to robust sales that overshadowed increased expenses. The net loss for the June quarter was reported at 508.7 million rupees, a notable improvement compared to the previous year's substantial loss. This financial performance showcases the company's progressive trajectory in the market.

items.title: DLF Q1 Results: Profit rises 4% to Rs 794 crore; revenue declines 46%
items.description: DLF Ltd has recorded a modest profit growth of four percent in the June quarter, though total income suffered a notable drop, affecting its financial outcomes. The increase in net profit stems from better performance in associate and joint ventures. However, a significant downturn in sales bookings occurred due to postponed housing project launches.

items.title: Kansai Nerolac Q1 profit rises 5%; approves Rs 601 crore capacity expansion
items.description: Paintmaker cites healthy demand despite geopolitical disruptions; expects festive season to support growth.

items.title: MakeMyTrip Q1 bookings rise 20%; AI assistant drives growth
items.description: MakeMyTrip reported a 19.9% year-on-year rise in Q1 gross bookings to $2.85 billion, while revenue and adjusted operating profit increased despite travel disruptions. Strong growth across hotels, buses and AI-powered Myra 2.0 reinforced confidence in India’s long-term travel demand.
